tooltips.aum: AUM = Σ (principal_usd + accrued_interest) of every active position. 24h Δ compares to positions snapshot ≤ 24h ago.
tooltips.nav: NAV = today's snapshot from the nav_snapshots collection (real, not synthetic). 24h Δ vs yesterday's snapshot.
tooltips.revenue: Revenue MTD = Σ fee_amount on confirmed transactions since the first of this month. YTD since Jan 1.
tooltips.volume: Volume = Σ amount on confirmed subscribe + redeem transactions in the selected range.
tooltips.active: Active clients = distinct org_id values across positions with status='active'.
tooltips.ops: Ops queue = approvals with status='pending'. KYB / alerts / webhooks shown in the right-side panel.
